identification: Mixed lot of 6 framed Launceston/Tasmanian works: Geoff Tyson (1911-86) watercolour of a park with fountain and church tower, signed and dated '67 (Launceston City Park); Picturesque Atlas of Australasia hand-coloured wood engraving 'Launceston from Cataract Bridge' c.1886-88; engraving 'Post Office, Launceston'; small engraving of a Launceston building; reproduction iris print; small unsigned oil of a Tasmanian mountain. Value sits almost entirely in the Tyson watercolour (small, about 20x30 cm image).
